title: litt.md — launch film
logline: For people building with Claude Code: litt.md turns a person's taste into rules, tokens and components an agent builds with, and checks it against. Open the gallery.

scenes.intent: Name the problem in one breath: agents build in everyone's taste, not yours.

beats.note: 'Agents build in everyone's taste.' rises word by word, fg
line 1 steps back to the grey; 'Not yours.' rises (the scene's moment)
'Not' steps back; only 'yours.' keeps fg

elements.note: First line of the scene's one statement: a single <Headline> (display, 112) holding l1 and l2 as block spans, left on the safe edge, vertically centred. fg, then the grey at b2.
Second line, same Headline. fg; at b3 'Not' dims and 'yours.' keeps fg.
Inline span inside l2, pinned to text-fg. Emphasis by ink.

scenes.motion: Solid canvas, no light. b1: l1 maskUp by words (responsive). b2: l1 `dim` as l2 maskUp by words on the expressive spring — the one moment. b3: l2 `dim`, 'yours.' keeps fg. Camera 1 → 1.03 with origin on the safe left edge (x 96). Nothing exits; hard cut into the light.

scenes.intent: Install the components, don't copy them: one command, namespaced, never restyles the host.

<Body>, the grey.
<Window title="~/app"> 1024 wide, Terminal: '$ npx shadcn add @litt/button' (typed), then '✔ components/litt/button.tsx' and '✔ tokens as --litt-*, host untouched'.

A flat Card under the terminal (same 1024 width, 32px gap): the installed component — <Button variant="primary">Get started</Button> beside <Button>Read the docs</Button>, and a mono caption '@litt/button 2026.10.20' on the right in the grey.

scenes.motion: Solid canvas. b1: headline maskUp lines (responsive); label fade; sub rise. b2: m.type the command (cps ~24) with the prompt waiting; b3: output lines rise, list stagger. b4: the preview card `settle` — the expressive moment — its buttons with it. Camera 1 → 1.03.

scenes.intent: Motion in three tiers, quick by default, with one expressive moment per view — shown, not told.

expressive row fills on the expressive spring, settling last — the scene's moment (bounce 0.12 is a ~0.3% overshoot: the tiers read by timing against the shared end mark)

text.sub: Three tiers, one moment per view.
